subject: english
prompt:
Tired of a wobbly chair? At Fix-It Saturday, volunteers can help you tighten a loose leg and learn a repair skill. Bring one small item to the community hall, 10 a.m.–noon. “The easiest way to give your things a second life!” Reserve a place today.

Which description best fits this text?

options.text: A neutral report presenting a controlled repair experiment
A diary entry recounting one person’s visit to a workshop
A public timetable listing the service’s weekly opening hours
A persuasive advertisement that promotes a repair event and urges readers to reserve a place

answer.explanation: 正解D：檢查吸引注意的問句、正向宣稱與 Reserve a place today 的行動呼籲，可辨識廣告的說服目的；同時把時間、地點等可核實資訊與宣傳性評語分開。

solutionStrategy: 檢查吸引注意的問句、正向宣稱和呼籲行動，辨識廣告的說服目的，也把可核實的活動資訊與宣稱分開。
solutionSteps: 注意開頭以讀者問題抓注意，接著說明服務能協助修理物品。
找出時間、地點和 Bring one small item 等參加資訊。
辨認 Reserve a place today 是促使讀者採取行動的呼籲。
把 easiest 等宣傳性評語視為廣告宣稱，不當成已證實的客觀比較。
判斷它是推廣修理服務並邀請報名的廣告，兼有具體活動安排。
